ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify whether assemblers should accept both old and new mnemonic names or only the new ones.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume assemblers should accept both old and new names for backward compatibility during a transition period.

ambiguities.text: The term 'ABORT' for opcode 0xfe is described as replacement for 'INVALID' but the semantic difference between abort and invalid behavior is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume ABORT has identical semantics to INVALID - both cause the EVM to halt and consume all remaining gas.

implicit_assumptions.description: All EVM tooling (compilers, debuggers, disassemblers) will be updated to recognize the new mnemonic names.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Tooling fragmentation where some tools use old names and others use new names, causing confusion in contract auditing and debugging.

implicit_assumptions.description: Documentation and educational materials will be updated to reflect the new naming conventions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Developer confusion when documentation uses different names than actual tooling, potentially leading to incorrect code or security misunderstandings.
